name: Google Drive Sync
description: Mirror Google Drive files and folders shared to the assistant's Workspace account into the content tree as text, with change/delete/un-share propagation, a budgeted download queue, and meta seeding at share roots and share points.
prerequisite: googleDrive block in pipeline-config.json; sync account registered in gog (service-account mailbox); DWD grant covers gog's Drive + Sheets scopes (VCS exclusion deferred until jeeves-watcher#253: it would also de-index the mirror)
